summary.headline: Suraj Estate FY26 presales rose 23% to INR615 crores, beating INR600 crore guidance, but net debt reached INR579.91 crores and PAT fell to INR90 crores.
summary.overview: Management reported Q4 FY26 total income of INR101 crores, EBITDA of INR52 crores (up 69% YoY) and PAT of INR11 crores, with FY26 EBITDA of INR223 crores at a 39.7% margin. Presales beat guidance, but realisation fell to about INR46,895 per sq ft on a shift to value-luxury and commercial sales, and the FY26 PAT decline was attributed to higher finance costs from land acquisitions. The company signed a binding MOU for a contiguous Mahim land parcel (about INR800 crores incremental GDV) and completed the Hally Pacific acquisition at Prabhadevi (INR30.40 crores, INR200 crores GDV). Residential presales slowed sharply in Q4, and FY27 presales guidance was deferred to the next call.

segments.name: Residential
segments.commentary: Q4 residential presales about INR74 crores after deducting commercial sales; management attributed the slowdown mainly to limited inventory (about INR150 crores unsold). FY26 average realisation fell as value-luxury launches replaced luxury projects such as Palette and Ocean Star.

segments.name: Commercial
segments.commentary: Suraj One Business Bay (launch INR1,200 crores GDV, plus INR800 crores from the Mahim MOU, combined over INR2,000 crores) is the main FY27 launch driver; management says it is entirely commercial, targets 25-30% margins on vacant-land projects, and about 8,000 sq ft retail is priced above INR1 lakh per sq ft.

guidance_outlook: FY27 presales guidance deferred to the next quarterly call; management wants combined residential and commercial guidance after the Mahim MOU reaches RERA stage.
FY27 residential launches of INR500-600 crores (management also cited INR600 crores committed earlier), with total FY27 launch pipeline of about INR1,400 crores including commercial.
FY27 average realisation expected at INR45,000-50,000 per sq ft; INR60,000 per sq ft applies to the upcoming pipeline average, lifted by Bandra land.
EBITDA margin guided at 35-40% for upcoming projects, with FY27 blended margin maintained at about 35%.
Net debt expected to be between INR600 crores and INR650 crores on a yearly basis, temporarily rising with launches.
Bandra (Mount Mary) project: two land parcels conveyed, balance acquisitions targeted over the next two quarters; launch at least a year away, roughly Q1 FY28.
risks_watch: Net debt rose to INR579.91 crores with weighted average cost about 13%; analysts flagged rating and refinancing risk, with no external rating currently.
Residential presales fell to about INR74 crores in Q4 with inventory near INR150 crores; launch timing for new residential projects remains uncertain.
Realisation trend: FY26 average INR46,895 per sq ft vs FY25 about INR54,586; FY27 guided lower at INR45,000-50,000.
FY27 presales guidance not yet provided; Mahim MOU and Bandra land acquisitions still pending, Bandra launch about FY28.
Management sensitivity: asked about the sharp share-price decline, management pointed to beating guidance and said other factors were outside its control.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand and the commercial pivot, but evasive on FY27 presales guidance, realisation, and the share-price fall; several answers were inconsistent, including the Q4 commercial sales split and GDV figures, which were corrected during the call.
key_quotes: What we have committed in terms of guidance, we've already achieved it.
We see good traction in the commercial. So, we have no doubt that our call on the commercial -- pivoting towards majorly on commercial is the right call.
I feel we should look at it more from the cash flow perspective rather than the market cap.

qa_highlights.question: Analyst asked for total GDV of ongoing projects and pipeline, plus FY27 revenue and EBITDA.
qa_highlights.answer: Ongoing unsold inventory about INR1,100 crores at current market value; upcoming carpet area 12.12 lakh sq ft, about INR7,500-7,600 crores GDV at INR60,000 per sq ft. Management declined FY27 revenue and EBITDA guidance and deferred presales guidance to the next call.

qa_highlights.question: Why did average realisation fall from about INR54,586 per sq ft in FY25 to about INR46,000 in FY26?
qa_highlights.answer: Product mix shift: value-luxury launches and commercial sales replaced luxury projects such as Palette (INR65,000-70,000 per sq ft) and Ocean Star (INR85,000-90,000 per sq ft).

qa_highlights.question: Will the Q3 commercial presales of INR200 crores and Q4 split be reconciled, and what margins apply to the Mahim project?
qa_highlights.answer: Q4 commercial presales about INR54.6 crores, residential about INR74 crores out of INR128 crores; part of the Q3 INR200 crores is recognised under POCM. Commercial margins guided at 25-30% on vacant-land projects, with historically acquired land earning higher margins.

qa_highlights.question: How will rising debt be handled, and what is the net debt target?
qa_highlights.answer: Debt added for vacant-land acquisitions; net debt expected to rise temporarily with launches but stay between INR600 crores and INR650 crores on a yearly basis. Management said cash flow visibility matters more than market cap.

qa_highlights.question: What is the weighted average cost of debt and is the Mahim MOU binding?
qa_highlights.answer: Weighted average interest rate about 13%, up from 12-12.5% earlier due to costlier land-related acquisition funding. The MOU is binding, with some advance paid and not the full INR75 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Why is presales guidance delayed, and when will residential inventory expand?
qa_highlights.answer: Guidance waits until the Mahim land reaches RERA stage and amalgamation is done, to give combined residential and commercial guidance. Residential inventory is limited at about INR150 crores; management said a couple of society redevelopment tie-ups will be announced shortly.

capex_capacity: Bandra (Mount Mary) project: two land parcels already conveyed; balance land acquisitions targeted over the next two quarters; preparatory feasibility work started; launch at least a year away (roughly Q1 FY28).

Upcoming portfolio carpet area about 12.12 lakh sq ft, estimated at about INR7,000-7,600 crores GDV at an average INR60,000 per sq ft; about 2.76 lakh sq ft of this is from Bandra, where current market rate cited at INR1-1.5 lakh per sq ft.

Ongoing portfolio unsold inventory estimated at about INR1,100 crores at current market value; total sold area of ongoing projects 5.66 lakh sq ft; receivables of INR2,105 crores from sold and unsold areas.

FY27 launch pipeline of about INR1,400 crores including commercial: residential INR500-600 crores (management also cited INR600 crores committed earlier) spread over 3-9 months, and commercial INR800 crores from the Mahim MOU, with Suraj One Business Bay fully launched.

Mahim MOU is binding; contiguous to Suraj One Business Bay, adds about 1.5 lakh sq ft saleable carpet area and about INR800 crores incremental GDV; some advance paid, not yet the full INR75 crores per the analyst's figure.
demand_pricing: FY26 presales INR615 crores (+23% YoY, vs INR600 crores guidance); sold area 1,31,167 sq ft (+42% YoY); collections INR421 crores (+9% YoY).

Q4 FY26 presales INR128 crores, of which about INR54.6 crores from the commercial project (Suraj One Business Bay) and about INR74 crores residential; Q4 sold area 27,968 sq ft at about INR45,618 per sq ft.
Q3 FY26 commercial presales about INR200 crores; management said part of this is recognised under POCM.

FY26 average realisation INR46,895 per sq ft vs about INR54,586 in FY25; management attributed the fall to a mix shift from luxury (Palette at INR65,000-70,000, Ocean Star at INR85,000-90,000 per sq ft) to value-luxury and commercial.
Residential presales slowdown attributed mainly to limited inventory of about INR150 crores; management said there was no buyer slowdown.

Commercial: Suraj One Business Bay (INR1,200 crores GDV, plus INR800 crores from Mahim MOU) is entirely commercial; about 8,000 sq ft retail priced above INR1 lakh per sq ft; commercial margin 25-30% on vacant-land projects.

FY27 guidance: average realisation INR45,000-50,000 per sq ft; EBITDA margin 35-40% for upcoming projects, blended about 35%; presales guidance deferred to next call, to be given jointly for residential and commercial.
